metadata.title: [ENHANCEMENT]: Add Disconnect and Test actions to connected MCP catalog servers
metadata.author: a-effort

description:
## Overview

In the React Admin UI's MCP server catalog, registering ("connect") a catalog entry creates a `Gateway` record but the catalog view offers no follow-up actions on that entry. Add **Disconnect** and **Test** actions for catalog entries that are already registered, so users don't have to navigate away from the catalog to manage what they just connected. [Design](https://github.com/IBM/mcp-context-forge/issues/4732)

**Part of Epic:** #4093
**Deferred to:** post-RC2 (after #4098)

## Context

The current catalog API (`/admin/mcp-registry/*`) exposes only list, register, status, and bulk-register. Once an entry is registered it becomes a regular `Gateway` row — there's no catalog-level lifecycle. The existing gateway endpoints already cover the underlying operations:

- `DELETE /gateways/{gateway_id}` — disconnect
- `POST /admin/gateways/test` — test connectivity (allowlist already includes registered gateway URLs)
- `POST /gateways/{gateway_id}/tools/refresh` — live probe + tool rediscovery

The blocker is that `CatalogServer` (`mcpgateway/schemas.py`) exposes `is_registered: bool` but no `gateway_id`, so the React app can't resolve a registered catalog row to the gateway it should act on.

## Scope

### Backend
- [ ] Add `gateway_id: Optional[str]` to `CatalogServer` schema.
- [ ] Populate `gateway_id` in `catalog_service.get_catalog_servers()` from the URL-match query that already sets `is_registered`.
- [ ] Invalidate the registry cache after `DELETE /gateways/{id}` succeeds for a `created_via="catalog"` gateway, so `is_registered` flips back without a stale read (mirroring the invalidation in `register_catalog_server`).

### Frontend (React prototype)
- [ ] Show a contextual action menu on each catalog card based on `is_registered`:
  - Not registered → existing **Connect** action.
  - Registered → **Disconnect** and **Test** actions.
- [ ] **Disconnect**: confirm dialog → `DELETE /gateways/{gateway_id}` → refetch catalog list.
- [ ] **Test**: `POST /admin/gateways/test` with the catalog entry's URL → surface status code and latency from `GatewayTestResponse`.
- [ ] Disable **Test** when `requires_oauth_config === true` (gateway exists but is `enabled=false` pending OAuth).
- [ ] Respect permissions: only render Disconnect with `gateways.delete`, Test with `gateways.read`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Registered catalog entries surface Disconnect and Test actions in the React UI.
- [ ] Disconnecting from the catalog view removes the underlying gateway and updates the catalog card state without a manual refresh.
- [ ] Test action shows a clear success/failure indicator with latency.
- [ ] Actions are hidden or disabled for users without the relevant permissions, and for OAuth entries that haven't completed configuration.
- [ ] No regression in the existing Connect flow.

## If possible

In the confirm disconnect dialog, list any virtual servers that will be affected.
